title: /api/assignments spreads unvalidated request body into Firestore and skips server-side validateAssignmentQuestions
impact: batch.set(ref, { ...data, ... }) enables mass assignment of arbitrary fields on assignments docs, omits server-side validateAssignmentQuestions(data.questions) that the client UI relies on, and throws an uncaught error on invalid dueDate strings.
recommendation: Validate the POST payload with a strict zod schema whitelisting allowed fields, call validateAssignmentQuestions(data.questions) on the server, and validate dueDate before constructing a Date.

title: Role spoofing via client-supplied role/userRole in /api/chat and /api/student/tutor
impact: Both routes read userRole/role from req.json() instead of the server-fetched Firestore user profile, allowing students to request teacher navigation prompts in /api/chat and teachers to bypass the student role check in /api/student/tutor.
recommendation: Use userData.role from Firestore exclusively instead of trusting role fields in req.json(), and return 400 for missing fields and 403 for role mismatches.

title: /api/teacher/network/membership creates new free networks with subscriptionStatus 'none' and aiBudgetLimit 0
impact: Creating a network via /api/teacher/network/membership sets subscriptionStatus: 'none' and aiBudgetLimit: 0 (unlike /api/auth/register which sets 'active' and 50), causing checkBudget and reserveBudget to reject all AI requests for the new network.
recommendation: Use a shared helper to initialize new organization documents consistently across /api/auth/register and /api/teacher/network/membership.

title: withAuthorizedRequest crashes on empty-body POST requests, masks unhandled route errors as 400, and causes duplicate Auth/Firestore reads
impact: Unconditional JSON.parse(raw) fails with 400 on bodyless POST requests (e.g. /api/teacher/network/invites), wrapping execute() inside the auth catch block turns unhandled 500 route exceptions into 400 'Unable to authorize request', and not passing caller/profile to handlers causes 17 routes to re-verify tokens or re-read users/{uid}.
recommendation: Treat empty request bodies as {}, move execute() outside the auth-parsing try/catch, and pass { caller, profile, organizationId, body } to wrapped route handlers.

title: Zero zod input validation across all 26 JSON routes; /api/notebook/chat crashes on empty messages array and /api/auth/request-access falls through on unknown action
impact: None of the 26 JSON routes use zod; passing messages: [] to /api/notebook/chat throws TypeError at notebook.ts:L39; unknown action values in /api/auth/request-access fall through to public submission; and /api/ai/generate and /api/ai/parse lack upper bounds on count and text.
recommendation: Add zod request schemas to all 26 JSON routes and validate non-empty arrays and explicit action enums.

title: /api/support/report swallows Firestore write errors and returns HTTP 200 success
impact: If writing to support_tickets fails or adminDb is uninitialized, the route catches the error, logs PII/screenshots to stdout, and still returns 200 { success: true, ticketId } to the client.
recommendation: Return 500/503 when Firestore persistence fails, validate screenshot payloads, and populate user identity fields from the authenticated profile.

title: Upstream error bodies leaked in /api/github/stats and /api/checkout, plus unthrottled invite code validation in /api/auth/teacher-code
impact: github/stats and checkout return raw upstream error bodies (details: text, details: polarError.body) in production, and /api/auth/teacher-code action 'validate' has no rate limit and only 32 bits of entropy for admin-generated SCORP-XXXX-XXXX codes.
recommendation: Omit raw upstream error bodies in production responses, add checkRateLimit to /api/auth/teacher-code and /api/auth/request-access, and increase invite code entropy to >= 64 bits.

title: Contradictory dynamic/revalidate config on /api/github/stats and missing maxDuration on multi-call AI routes
impact: export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic' on github/stats overrides revalidate = 3600 so every request hits api.github.com live without a timeout; meanwhile /api/grade and /api/ai/parse run sequential Gemini loops without exporting maxDuration.
recommendation: Remove dynamic = 'force-dynamic' from github/stats, add fetch timeouts, export maxDuration on AI routes, and parallelize batch/question AI calls with bounded concurrency.

title: Non-transactional approve/submit in /api/auth/request-access and Auth-before-Firestore deletion order in DELETE /api/account
impact: approve and submit in /api/auth/request-access perform multi-step reads and writes without a transaction, and DELETE /api/account deletes the Firebase Auth user before deleting users/{uid}, preventing authenticated retry if the final Firestore delete fails.
recommendation: Wrap approve and submit in adminDb.runTransaction, and delete users/{uid} before calling adminAuth.deleteUser(caller.uid).
